description: Agent Waste and Recycling Records: submit diversion and recovery records with the processing, reuse, disposal and pickup records they answer to: each diversion claim with its id, reference, the moments its period starts and ends, the diversion rate it states and the quantity it counts as diverted; each disposal and landfill record with its id, reference, quantity and the moment disposed; each processing or reuse record with its id, reference, its kind (processing or reuse), quantity recovered and the moment recovered; each diversion entry with its id, reference, the claim it counts toward, the processing or reuse record it counts and the quantity; each pickup log entry with its id, reference and the moment picked up. The signed report gives the claims and the totals behind them, each claim’s diversion rate against the rate the processing, reuse and disposal totals dated in its period support, each processing or reuse record against the diversion entries counting it, each claim’s period against the pickup log, and each diversion entry against the record behind it, and counts them, and names divergent diversion records: a diversion rate the disposal and recycling totals do not support, material counted as diverted in two records at once, a diversion claim for a period the pickup log does not cover, and a diverted quantity with no processing or reuse record behind it; then a diversion entry counting more than the record it names holds and a claim whose diverted quantity its own diversion entries do not add up to, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No claims, claims stating no period, no pickup log beside dated claims, or no processing or reuse records beside diversion entries leaves those points unverified. Records match by letters and digits, a rate reads as recovered over recovered and disposed in the period to the tenth of a percent, a claimed rate above it is unsupported, and a period is covered when the pickup log holds a pickup dated in it. This reads whether every diversion rate and recovered tonnage rests on processing, reuse and disposal records counted once. Verdict waste_diversion_divergent, waste_diversion_partial, waste_diversion_unverified or waste_diversion_consistent. POST /api/waste-diversion-check. Reads the waste and recycling records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it hauls no waste, operates no facility, contacts no regulator, hauler or disposal site and issues no permit or certification, which stay with the waste operation, its haulers, its facilities and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Waste and Recycling Records reads a waste operation’s own records: waste manifest records, hauler permit records, disposal and landfill records, recycling processing records, diversion and recovery records, pickup and collection log records, facility and scale records and contamination report records, each against the hauler permit, facility, receiving and disposal records, the waste types, areas and dates in the pickup log, the manifests and the dates the record states, the inbound, outbound and residue records, the processing, reuse, disposal and pickup totals, the service record, the scale tickets and dispositions, or the follow-up entries and the inspected load counts on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the waste stream: what the manifest shows, what the disposal record supports, what the permits cover, and whether the diversion claims and pickup logs hold up; it reads records about waste streams and the people who move them, not live environmental monitoring and not cleanup services: the Agent Energy family reads utility and generation records, the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records, the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety file and the Agent Aviation Records family reads an air operator’s flight and maintenance paper trail, while this family reads a waste operation’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-waste-recycling-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-waste-recycling-records/.
